_metadata.description: Shared maturity-go/autofix adoption, structure-health fixers, format-preserving service.json edits, and standardized auto-fixable coverage.

requirements.title: Preview is dry-run and apply is idempotent
requirements.description: PreviewFixConfig produces fix candidates without writing; ApplyFixConfig composes the service.json edits and is idempotent (apply-twice yields one change) via schema-aware CanFix re-checks.

validation.notes: autofix/autofix_test.go proves preview is dry-run and apply composes edits idempotently; handlers/validation/handler_test.go proves the RPCs dry-run by default and write only on apply.

requirements.title: Format-preserving service.json edits
requirements.description: service.json fixes use targeted node edits that preserve key order and unknown fields and keep HTML characters escaped, never a blind full-file map round-trip that reorders keys or drops fields.

validation.notes: svcedit/svcedit_test.go proves byte-identical round-trip, key-order/unknown-field preservation, and escape preservation.

requirements.title: Fixers cover the deterministic majority of findings
requirements.description: Fixers add a missing health/freshness check, create a missing surface directory and README, and otherwise remediate the deterministic majority of structure findings; each rule reports its FixClass so a high fraction of findings report autofix_available=true.

validation.notes: autofix/autofix_test.go covers surface-dir creation, README creation, the rule filter, FixClass resolution, and the no-op-when-conformant path.

requirements.title: Adopt the shared maturity-go/autofix helper and coverage metric
requirements.description: structure-health registers its fixers against the shared packages/maturity-go/autofix registry (FixClass, Candidate, Preview/Apply, AutofixableCount) and emits the standardized autofixable_count/autofixable_total in the shared assessment response, so auto-fixable coverage is readable uniformly by Test Genie and meta-optimization.

validation.notes: autofix/autofix_test.go exercises the shared registry orchestrator; the assessment response carries autofixable_count.
